verdict.rationale: Twilio Video exposes a REST API (Rooms, Recordings, Compositions), so asking for a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question. However, no evidence in the pack shows an OpenAPI or equivalent spec for download. The llms.txt file and markdown docs probes are AI-readable documentation, an adjacent feature rather than an API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
